text:
Tariq: Hi folks  I'm handing in my resignation today. Proposed last day 2024-11-22. Can we start offboarding? Questions: benefits end date, COBRA timing, 401(k) rollover process, returning a company HSM key + laptop, and on-call handoff for my rotation.
Lina (People Ops): Sorry to hear, Tariq. Quick answers: benefits end EOD on 2024-11-22. COBRA packet emailed/mailed within 14 business days after that date; election window typically 60 days. We'll include carrier contacts and estimated premiums. 401(k) rollover options will be sent by Payroll and the plan provider.
Tariq: Thanks. For 401(k) can Payroll share a checklist? I want to compare leaving balance vs rollover to my new provider.
Payroll: We will email a step-by-step: 1) distribution options, 2) rollover forms, 3) estimated timeline (usually 2-4 weeks). We'll include required tax forms and contact at the plan admin.
Tariq: I have a company HSM token and a monitor plus my Mac. Asset tag RDN-20242. What's the preferred return flow?
IT-bot: Please confirm serial numbers to generate pre-paid label. Default: ship device and HSM via prepaid label; IT schedules secure wipe the business day after last active day unless manager requests later. If HSM needs signature on receipt, we'll note that.
Tariq: Confirm asset_tag RDN-20242, serial SN-CH4P9, HSM-ID HSM-88. Prefer shipping. Please delay wipe until after the handoff on 11/20.
Oncall Lead: We'll need a 30-min run-through of your on-call runbook and escalation paths. Can you block 11/18 or 11/19? Also list any long-lived deploy keys you maintain.
Tariq: I'll block 11/18 11:00 PT and add a short runbook and incident playbooks to the repo. I'll flag deploy keys in the doc.
Security: We'll run an access audit 2024-11-23 09:00 PT and revoke SSO/org tokens after confirming handoffs. Please remove any personal tokens from dotfiles and repos; rotate service-account keys if applicable.
Lina (People Ops): Exit interview  30 min mornings available week after last day. We'll send Calendly. Final paycheck + PTO payout will be processed next payroll cycle; Payroll notified. COBRA & 401(k) info will be emailed within 14 business days after 11/22. I'll DM you the locker code and/or the prepaid label when created. Thanks, and we'll coordinate the schedule.
Tariq: Appreciate it  thanks everyone for the quick turnaround.
